Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material is blood plasma. While plasma is an extracellular fluid and not a 'cell lysate' in the biological sense, within the provided ontology mapping rules, it represents the bulk unfractionated proteome of the sample provided (similar to a total extract), and does not meet the criteria for 'purified protein or complex' (no affinity capture of a specific bait) or other specialized scopes like secretome (which usually refers to conditioned media/secreted proteins specifically enriched from a cell culture context).

primary_biological_variables.matched_definition: Comparison between diseased and healthy or unaffected controls.
evidence: Plasma samples from 386 patients were classified into four groups: control (CON) (n = 62), unstable angina (UA) (n = 62), STEMI (n = 182), and NSTEMI (n = 80).
The control subjects were recruited from patients who underwent conventional coronary angiography for atypical chest discomfort and were found to have normal coronary arteries.

replicate_hints: 30 plasma samples were randomly selected from CON, UA, and STEMI groups (10 in each group) at T2 time point for DIA-based biomarker screening.
evidence: Plasma samples from 386 patients were classified into four groups: control (CON) (n = 62), unstable angina (UA) (n = 62), STEMI (n = 182), and NSTEMI (n = 80).
T1 was defined as 0<T1≤2 h after the onset of the chest pain; 2< T2≤8 h; 8<T3≤24 h; T4>24 h.
Plasma was collected from the same patients at the 4 timepoints (T1-T4) to ensure consistency in the comparison.
A total of 70 DAPs were identified, with 33 upregulated and 37 downregulated in the STEMI group compared to the CON group.
